csv_project_name: Engineering Svc For US 35 Bridge Deck Replacement
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: Project Development Services - Bridge Rehabilitation, Replace Superstructure on SR-67 over Buck Creek (NB & SB), Bridge Deck replacement on US-35 over Cardinal Greenway (NB & SB) and SR-3 over US-35 (NB & SB), and Bridge Thin Deck Overlay on US-35 over White River The selected firm shall perform preliminary engineering and plan development services necessary to produce construction contract documents in accordance with the INDOT project development process. The selected firm shall complete Bridge Design, Road Design (if needed), Right-of-Way Plan Development (including R/W Engineering, Title Research and Staking), Topographic Survey, Ecological Surveys, Environmental Documentation, Permits Applications, Pavement Design, Utility Coordination, and Construction Phase Services. Other services may also be provided if needed such as Archeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigation, professional public outreach and marketing services, and Wetland Mitigation. INDOT will provide the following if needed Geotechnical Engineering, and Real Estate Services. The INDOT Project Manager and the Consultant will schedule the Scoping Meeting within two (2) weeks of the Notice of Selection. The selected firm's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item. The contract may utilize the INDOT eInvoice application.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Biological Studies/Natural Resources, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Habitat Restoration/Wetlands Restoration
